mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate accommodative policy support.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS drops below 0.25%, it triggers aggressive monetary policy expectations that compress equity discount rates, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to sustained low-rate environment.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the signal correlation with returns drops below 0.15 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate accelerating economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST is followed by positive 20-day returns in > 40% of cases, or the interaction correlation with returns falls below -0.25.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits to generate positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5 and declines, or the regime-specific return differential is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor market conditions, increasing consumer income and spending capacity to drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the signal correlation with returns falls below 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings growth to produce negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's predictive power (Rank IC) remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in CPIAUCSL and RSAFS is followed by positive 20-day returns in > 40% of cases, or the interaction effect size drops below -0.15.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3%), a rise in FEDFUNDS signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations to produce negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the regime-specific return differential is insignificant (p > 0.05).
